review_evidence: All 58 formal-source files were inspected at repository scale; a declaration scan finds hundreds of theorem/example declarations, including factorial_pos, factorial_nonzero, and numerous hyperreal arithmetic statements.

The README and formal source develop hyperreal numbers, infinitesimals and infinite elements, standard-part style constructions, derivatives, integrals, and related algebraic/analytic examples rather than serving as implementation tooling.
The source therefore supplies independently searchable mathematical definitions, statements, and proofs even where parts of the development are exploratory.
summary: Retain hyper-lean: it contains an extensive Lean development of hyperreal/infinitesimal algebra and related elementary analysis statements.

summary: Read the full checkout listing and, for the 55 changed/added files in this unit, ran a grep census for theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom. 52 of the 55 files matched at least one declaration keyword; the bulk (Hyper/*.lean, Hyper/probes/*.lean, Hyper/theory/HyperHahn.lean) are substantial hyperreal/infinitesimal algebra developments (structures, instances, theorems, up to 253 declarations in Hyper/HyperList.lean), consistent with the prior review's own summary for this source. The three files with no declaration-keyword hit (probes/simple_cos.lean, probes/test_cos_simple.lean, probes/test_hyper.lean) were read in full: each is a short debug/probe script consisting of import, open, comments, and #eval!/#check/#eval commands exercising the HyperReal API (cos, sin, epsilon, omega, standard part). Per FILTER-007 these executable commands take the files outside the pure-import unilateral class, and they demonstrate real usage of the library's formal definitions rather than holding no mathematical content, so FILTER-004(1)'s format-aware 'no formal declarations' test is not met either. Also read check_factorial.lean (#eval calls into Hyper.HyperTranscendental.factQ) and hyper.lean (real example/native_decide proofs plus calls into IsHyperReal instance lemmas eps_omega_comm, eps_lt_omega, eps_sq_ne_eps): both are genuine math-adjacent content. No file in this unit meets the FILTER-002/FILTER-004 evidence bar for hard exclusion. Retain all 55.
